requirements.text: WHEN the list view is displayed, the system shall render the Key, Title, Status, Created, and Updated column headers as clickable sort controls and shall show the active sort direction on the active column
WHEN the user clicks the Attributes column header in the list view, the system shall not change the sort order
WHEN the user clicks a column header that is not the active sort attribute, the system shall sort by that attribute using its default direction
WHEN the user clicks the header of the currently active sort attribute, the system shall reverse the sort direction
WHEN the user changes the sort through a column header click, the system shall update the sort menu selection and direction to match
WHEN the user changes the sort through the sort menu, the system shall update the column header direction indicator to match
The system shall label the sortable list columns exactly Key, Title, Status, Created, and Updated, matching the sort menu labels for those attributes
WHEN the list view is displayed, the system shall render a Created column immediately before the Updated column
WHEN a Created or Updated list cell is displayed, the system shall show relative time text with the full date-time available on hover
WHILE the list view is active, the system shall offer Status as a sort attribute in the sort menu and the mobile sort list
WHILE the board or swimlane view is active, the system shall offer exactly the pre-change sort attributes, excluding Status
WHEN sort preferences change in one view scope, the system shall leave the other view scope's stored sort preferences unchanged
WHEN the application is reloaded, the system shall restore each view scope's persisted sort preferences independently
Sort preferences shall persist in browser localStorage under the existing markdown-ticket-sort-preferences key with per-scope values, never in URL params or backend storage
The existing E2E data-testids ticket-table, ticket-row-*, sort-menu, and sort-controls shall remain stable through this change
Sortable column headers shall expose aria-sort reflecting the active attribute and direction, plus a visible direction glyph
The status lifecycle sort order shall be a dedicated constant; STATUS_CONFIG.order and VALID_STATUSES shall not be mutated or repurposed
Timestamp cells inside clickable table rows shall be non-interactive (no nested interactive element)
Board and swimlane within-column sorting behavior and Documents view sorting shall remain unchanged
IF the stored sort preferences value has an unrecognized shape (including the pre-change flat shape), THEN the system shall fall back to per-scope defaults without throwing

WHEN tickets are sorted by status, the system shall order them by lifecycle — ascending: Proposed, Approved, In Progress, On Hold, Implemented, Partially Implemented, Rejected; descending: the reverse — with unknown statuses positioned after all known statuses in either direction
requirements.sourceRef: CR §5 Functional AC-6; lead decision 2026-09-30 (pin last both directions)

scenarios.title: Clicking a header sorts by its default direction
scenarios.given: I am viewing a project's list and the tickets are in mixed order
scenarios.when: I click the Title column header
scenarios.then: the rows reorder by title ascending (Title's default direction) and the Title header shows that direction while other headers show none

scenarios.title: Clicking the active header flips direction
scenarios.given: the Title header is the active sort in ascending direction
scenarios.when: I click the Title header again
scenarios.then: the rows reverse to title descending and the header direction indicator flips to descending

scenarios.title: Clicking the Attributes header changes nothing
scenarios.given: I am viewing the list with any active sort
scenarios.when: I click the Attributes column header
scenarios.then: the row order and the active sort attribute and direction are unchanged

scenarios.title: A header click updates the sort menu with matching labels
scenarios.given: I am viewing the list and its column headings read Key, Title, Status, Created, and Updated
scenarios.when: I click the Status column header
scenarios.then: the sort menu shows Status selected with the same direction as the header, and the menu label matches the column heading exactly

scenarios.title: A sort menu change updates the header indicator
scenarios.given: a column header is the active sort in ascending direction
scenarios.when: I select a different attribute in the sort menu
scenarios.then: the previously active header loses its direction indicator and the newly selected attribute's header shows the menu's direction

scenarios.title: Created column renders before Updated with relative times
scenarios.given: tickets with known created and updated times
scenarios.then: a Created column appears immediately before the Updated column, each cell shows a relative time such as 'an hour ago', and hovering a cell shows the full date-time

scenarios.title: Status appears in sort options only for the list
scenarios.given: my project offers list and board views
scenarios.when: I open the sort menu and mobile sort list in list view, then the sort menu in board view
scenarios.then: the list options include Status while the board options are unchanged and exclude Status

scenarios.title: List and board sorts persist independently
scenarios.given: the list sorts by Updated descending and the board sorts by Key descending
scenarios.when: I change the list sort to Title, switch to the board, and reload the page
scenarios.then: the board still sorts by Key descending, and returning to the list shows Title sorting still in place

scenarios.title: Status sorts in lifecycle order with unknown last
scenarios.given: tickets spanning Proposed, Approved, In Progress, On Hold, Implemented, Partially Implemented, Rejected, plus one ticket with an unknown status
scenarios.when: I sort by Status ascending and then flip to descending
scenarios.then: ascending orders rows Proposed, Approved, In Progress, On Hold, Implemented, Partially Implemented, Rejected with the unknown-status ticket last; descending reverses the known lifecycle order and the unknown-status ticket is still last

obligations.title: View-scoped sort storage: one localStorage key holding Record<SortScope, SortPreferences>, sanitized reads, per-scope merge writes
Clickable list headers: default-direction first click, flip on repeat, aria-sort + glyph state, Attributes static
Single-state two-way sync: headers and dropdown write the same route-handler state through onSortPreferencesChange
List column labels match registry labels; Created column before Updated; fixed-mode RelativeTimestamp cells
Status comparator: CR_STATUS_SORT_ORDER lifecycle rank, unknown statuses last in both directions, no repurposing of existing status arrays
Per-scope attribute registry: list scope adds Status (SortMenu + hamburger), board scope unchanged five attributes
Preserve existing E2E testids (ticket-table, ticket-row-*, sort-menu*, sort-controls) and board/documents sort behavior through the rewrite
Sort-menu surface spec gains the Status icon row (list scope) at the UX permanent-owner step

testPlans.title: sortTickets status case: lifecycle order, both directions, unknown pinned last
View-scoped sort storage: per-scope read/write, cross-scope isolation, stale-shape fallback
Per-scope attribute registry: board five unchanged, list order Key/Title/Status/Priority/Created/Updated, CR_STATUS_SORT_ORDER contents
List view E2E: header-click sorting, dropdown sync, labels, Created column + non-interactive timestamps, status order, per-view persistence, preserved testids
